comments.body:
Not hard to pull. Used 1 qmp. I don't have Greek either. My maritime fame was 20k when I pulled it.

1. Talk to Roaming Alchemist outside Athens Tavern
2. Was Intercepted at 1317,3031 just East of Istanbul

2 Galleys who try to rush you. Very Fast
7 Turkish Carpets from Battle and a Lapis Hair Ornament for Chest reward.
